## endo sealers 


```{r, message=F, warning=F}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)

# 1. Define your group columns
group_cols <- c("Group.1...ProRoot", "Group.2...Ion.", "Group.3...BC", "Group.4...AH.Plus")

# 2. Reshape into long format and drop NAs (independent structure)
df_long <- endo_sealers %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(group_cols),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Score)

# Clean up group names
df_long$Group <- gsub("Group\\..*?\\.\\.\\.", "", df_long$Group)
df_long$Group <- sub("\\.$", "", df_long$Group)


# --- (1) One-Way Independent ANOVA (ProRoot, Ion, BC) ---
df_3groups <- df_long %>% filter(Group %in% c("ProRoot", "Ion", "BC"))

model_3_indep <- lm(Score ~ Group, data = df_3groups)
print("--- Independent One-Way ANOVA (ProRoot, Ion, BC) ---")
#summary(model_3_indep)
anova(model_3_indep)


# --- (2) Two-Sample Independent Pairwise Comparisons (All 4 Groups) ---
# Fit standard linear model without the Error() blocking term
model_all_indep <- lm(Score ~ Group, data = df_long)

# Compute estimated marginal means and run pairwise two-sample t-tests with Tukey adjustment
emms_indep <- emmeans(model_all_indep, ~ Group)
pairwise_indep <- pairs(emms_indep, adjust = "tukey")

print("--- Two-Sample Independent Pairwise Comparisons (Tukey-adjusted) ---")

pairwise_indep 
```


* observations marked with * are removed. 

* one way anova and two sample independent test was used 





## ph data 



### between sealer at every time point 


```{r, message=F, warning=F}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)

# Define time point columns
time_cols <- c("X3h", "X24h", "X48h", "X72h", "X7d", "X14d", "X21d", "X28d")


# =========================================================================
# PART (1): For each time point, compare Sealers (One-Way ANOVA + Pairwise)
# =========================================================================
print("=== PART 1: Comparisons Among Sealers at Each Time Point ===")

for (tp in time_cols) {
  cat("\n--------------------------------------------------\n")
  cat("Time Point:", tp, "\n")
  cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
  
  # Extract relevant subset and ensure Sealer is a factor
  df_tp <- ph_data %>% select(Sealer, all_of(tp)) %>% rename(Score = !!tp) %>% drop_na()
  df_tp$Sealer <- as.factor(df_tp$Sealer)
  
  # One-way ANOVA
  model_tp <- lm(Score ~ Sealer, data = df_tp)
  cat("\nOne-Way ANOVA:\n")
  #print(summary(model_tp))
  print(anova(model_tp))
  
  # Pairwise comparisons (Independent two-sample t-tests with Tukey adjustment)
  emms_tp <- emmeans(model_tp, ~ Sealer)
  pairwise_tp <- pairs(emms_tp, adjust = "tukey")
  
  cat("\nPairwise Comparisons (Tukey-adjusted):\n")
  print(pairwise_tp)
}
```


* at every time point, one way anova and two sample independent test was used 



### within each sealer 



```{r, message=F, warning=F}

# =========================================================================
# PART (2): Within each Sealer, compare Time Points (Repeated Measures ANOVA + Paired)
# =========================================================================
print("\n\n=== PART 2: Comparisons Among Time Points Within Each Sealer ===")

# Reshape data to long format and assign a Subject ID per row within each Sealer group
ph_long <- ph_data %>%
  group_by(Sealer) %>%
  mutate(SubjectID = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(time_cols),
    names_to = "TimePoint",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Score)

ph_long$TimePoint <- factor(ph_long$TimePoint, levels = time_cols)
ph_long$Sealer <- as.factor(ph_long$Sealer)

# Loop through each unique sealer to run repeated measures ANOVA and paired comparisons
unique_sealers <- unique(ph_long$Sealer)

for (s in unique_sealers) {
  cat("\n==================================================\n")
  cat("Sealer:", s, "\n")
  cat("==================================================\n")
  
  df_s <- ph_long %>% filter(Sealer == s)
  
  # Repeated Measures ANOVA (SubjectID as the blocking/error term)
  rm_anova <- aov(Score ~ TimePoint + Error(factor(SubjectID) / TimePoint), data = df_s)
  cat("\nRepeated Measures ANOVA:\n")
  summary(rm_anova)
  
  # Fit linear model equivalent for emmeans post-hoc testing
  model_s <- lm(Score ~ TimePoint + factor(SubjectID), data = df_s)
  emms_s <- emmeans(model_s, ~ TimePoint)
  
  # Pairwise paired t-tests across time points with Tukey adjustment
  pairwise_s <- pairs(emms_s, adjust = "tukey")
  
  cat("\nPairwise Comparisons Across Time Points (Paired t-tests, Tukey-adjusted):\n")
  print(pairwise_s)
}

```



* anova p value is in `Error: factor(SubjectID):TimePoint`. 


## viability 


### between groups at every time point 

```{r, message=F, warning=F}
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)

viability_data=viability 

# Ensure group and time are factors
viability_data$group <- as.factor(viability_data$group)
viability_data$time <- as.factor(viability_data$time)

groups <- unique(viability_data$group)

# =========================================================================
# PART (1): Between Groups at Each Time Point (Independent ANOVA & Tests)
# =========================================================================
print("=== PART 1: Comparisons Among Groups at Each Time Point ===")

time_points <- unique(viability_data$time)
for (tp in time_points) {
  cat("\n--------------------------------------------------\n")
  cat("Time Point:", tp, "\n")
  cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
  
  df_tp <- viability_data %>% filter(time == tp)
  
  model_tp <- lm(viability ~ group, data = df_tp)
  cat("\nOne-Way ANOVA (Groups):\n")
  print(anova(model_tp))
  
  emms_tp <- emmeans(model_tp, ~ group)
  pairwise_tp <- pairs(emms_tp, adjust = "tukey")
  
  cat("\nPairwise Comparisons Among Groups (Tukey-adjusted):\n")
  print(pairwise_tp)
}
```

* one way anova test and two sample independent t test was used


### within group across different time points 

```{r, message=F, warning=F}

# =========================================================================
# PART (2): Within Each Group Across Time Points (Repeated Measures & Paired Tests)
# =========================================================================
print("\n\n=== PART 2: Comparisons Among Time Points Within Each Group (Repeated Measures) ===")

for (g in groups) {
  cat("\n==================================================\n")
  cat("Group:", g, "\n")
  cat("==================================================\n")
  
  df_g <- viability_data %>% filter(group == g)
  
  # Assign a SubjectID per replicate across time points 
  # (Assumes rows are balanced/ordered identically across each time point)
  df_g <- df_g %>%
    group_by(time) %>%
    mutate(SubjectID = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # 1. One-Way Repeated Measures ANOVA
  rm_anova <- aov(viability ~ time + Error(factor(SubjectID) / time), data = df_g)
  cat("\nOne-Way Repeated Measures ANOVA:\n")
  print(summary(rm_anova))
  
  # 2. Fit linear model equivalent for emmeans (incorporating SubjectID blocking)
  model_g_rm <- lm(viability ~ time + factor(SubjectID), data = df_g)
  emms_g <- emmeans(model_g_rm, ~ time)
  
  # 3. Pairwise comparisons (functions as paired t-tests with Tukey adjustment)
  pairwise_g <- pairs(emms_g, adjust = "tukey")
  
  cat("\nPairwise Paired Comparisons Among Time Points (Tukey-adjusted):\n")
  print(pairwise_g)
}

```



* one way repeat anova test (p value in `Error: factor(SubjectID):time`) and two sample paired t test was used.
